summary: UDG-1..6 are resolved and audited. All ten decisions are final with gate=false, including the hard autonomy floor, bounded zero-checkpoint unattended sandbox, one canonical bundle-aware engine, layered recovery, deterministic typed-slice planner with central run-wide 8/3 leases, clean legacy-tier cutover over a core-owned situational rubric, and authoritative compact provenance state plus derived report. Completeness gate r8 verdict: PASS_IMPLEMENTATION_READY.
change_statement: No application, source, config, test or specification-document files were changed. This workflow changed only declared .work-state artifacts and engine-owned workflow state; no build or test command was run.

critical_observations.finding: Parent status steering interrupted a healthy worker's in-flight write and repeated pings caused starvation.
critical_observations.policy: Still Running, missing artifact or missing beacon is not hang proof; recover evidence first and never poll an active tool call.

critical_observations.finding: Prompt-only beacon behavior was nondeterministic across healthy workers.
critical_observations.policy: Runtime schedules/validates beacons; missing beacon never directly cancels or replays.

critical_observations.finding: Valid 144,926-byte JSON was rejected as unreadable; same-worker compaction to 90,468 bytes succeeded. Oversized final candidates were reliably transferred via artifact spill plus parent-side restore.
critical_observations.policy: Declare budget and return typed measured/budget size error; compact with same worker before restart or spill exact candidate for parent restore.

resolved_decisions.answer: D1-C core floor + profile gates; bounded zero-checkpoint unattended sandbox
constraints: ordinary full five-class human floor
explicit durable scoped grant only
zero prompt path in unattended mode
approved local/dev/domain/Web/Desktop/Android/iOS/resettable-data work remains available
floor/prohibited/ambiguous actions defer and independent work continues
terminal handoff when nothing remains
positive environment proof and effective-action classification

resolved_decisions.answer: D2-C deterministic typed-slice planner with central 8-global/3-per-role leases
constraints: one candidate per ready independent slice
risk/platform/package evidence may justify slices or mandatory roles but never directly multiplies slots
file count evidence only and tokens/time forbidden
manual-QA whole owner 1 and fan-in output owner 1
deterministic no-drop waves
ordered capability-compatible fallback or typed unavailable
overrides last only within safety bounds
plan identity includes formula, override, inventory, config, selection, mapping, slice-graph, rubric and bundle-dimension hashes
no heartbeat/TTL-only lease reclaim

resolved_decisions.answer: D3-A clean legacy-tier cutover; core-owned eight-dimension situational rubric
constraints: minimal/pragmatic/clean removed from config/input/output/state/docs/tests in one cutover
no alias/preset/deprecation window
nested/persisted legacy tier fails pre-planning as LEGACY_TIER_UNSUPPORTED with migration guidance
never silently maps or ranks
core versions scope/risk/reversibility/uncertainty/coupling/blast_radius/cost/evidence_quality plus aggregation and rationale
bundle dimensions namespaced/versioned/hashed additions only
collision/version/hash drift fail closed into plan identity

resolved_decisions.answer: D4-C core precedence plus strict canonical ambiguity
State-aware recovery-first with narrow slices, peer fan-in, whole manual-QA and runtime beacons
D7-C structured report retained with run + authoritative compact redacted provenance state
constraints: EffectiveConfigResolver.v1 shared authority
snapshot + monotonic ring latest 32 invalidation/fallback events with eviction on event 33
atomic CAS snapshot+event updates
logs telemetry only
resume from state without log/report; stale/corrupt authority fails closed
repo-relative paths/stable IDs/hashes only
absolute/home paths, tokens, secrets, raw args, personal content forbidden

resolved_decisions.answer: D8-C explicit > project config > exactly one compatible, else fail closed
Layered host+repository, authoritative states and no-proof-no-replay

dynamic_roster.formula: wdp-d2c-v1 builds a typed disjoint/closed slice DAG. Simultaneously ready independent slices each create one worker candidate; required capabilities determine role composition and multiplicity.
dynamic_roster.waves: Every excess ready slice is retained in a deterministic later wave; no slice is dropped.
dynamic_roster.leases: Atomic central CAS acquire/release; ambiguous liveness is not reclaimed from heartbeat/TTL alone.
dynamic_roster.overrides: Applied last and rejected atomically if they conflict with capability pool, caps, dependencies/disjointness, mandatory specialists, ownership or safety.
dynamic_roster.identity: Formula, override, inventory, config, selection, mapping, slice-graph, rubric and bundle-dimension hashes are immutable after launch and checked before dispatch.

unattended_mode.grant: SandboxGrant is identity-bound to session/branch/worktree/config/inventory/selection, allowed targets/resources/actions, expiry/revocation and provenance.
unattended_mode.continue_rule: DeferredAction records are durable, redacted, attributed and deduplicated; unrelated work continues, then one UnattendedHandoff terminates instead of polling.

host_probe.rule: Capability chooses queue/guarded/manual; no proof, no replay.

decision_agenda.answer: D1-C full ordinary floor plus zero-checkpoint bounded SandboxGrant with dev validation and defer-and-continue.
D2-C typed slice DAG; 8 run-wide/3 per-role central leases; manual-QA 1; fan-in owner 1; deterministic waves; safety-bounded last overrides.
D7-C human-readable effective-config/mapping report retained with run plus authoritative compact redacted per-run state (snapshot + ring32), logs non-authoritative.
D3-A clean legacy-tier cutover with core-owned versioned rubric and constrained namespaced bundle dimensions.

implementation_sequence_after_unblock: M1 config/catalog/claim/CAS diagnostics and provenance foundation
M2 typed slice planner, deterministic wave scheduler and central global leases in shadow mode

behavioral_oracles: ordinary floor asks vs unattended defer-with-zero-ask
positive dev target proof and redirect/script/subcommand expansion
identical slice plan yields identical roster/waves
nested global 8/per-role 3 caps and no TTL false reclaim
no-drop wave fairness and mandatory-risk priority
resume from compact state alone; ring32 eviction under CAS/crash windows; report regeneration
LEGACY_TIER_UNSUPPORTED on any nested/persisted legacy tier field; prose untouched
core rubric determinism/rationale; namespaced additions never override; collision/drift fail closed
